verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently reconcile Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, mechanics, and race restrictions. Preserve unsupported stamina, probability, and finish fields as null.
research_scope: Shining Slash — Strike Super acquisition and mechanics research.

verification_audit.method: Refreshed the existing verified record against current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence, the live canonical skills index, and independent Xenoverse 2 player documentation. PQ reward-tier semantics were preserved from the repository's existing verification.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Shining Slash was found. Canonical identity is Super / Strike.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Live canonical data and current Xenoverse 2 evidence identify Shining Slash as a 100-Ki Strike Super restricted to Earthling/Human and Saiyan CaCs.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Live canonical data records Parallel Quest 38 — Power Teams as a Basic Reward and explicitly records no Ultimate Finish requirement. Current independent Xenoverse 2 evidence corroborates the Earthling/Saiyan restriction and gap-closing behavior.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the reviewed sources establish the PQ38 route but do not provide sufficiently explicit evidence that the skill itself requires the Ultimate Finish.
verification_audit.cost_policy: Ki cost is documented as 100; stamina cost remains null because no reliable canonical stamina value was established.

records.name: Shining Slash
records.skill_description: A sword-based Strike Super that slashes the opponent; holding the input charges the attack and allows the user to move directly toward the targeted opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: 100 Ki sword-based Strike Super. Current Xenoverse 2 evidence describes the move as a strong gap closer: charging the attack can teleport/gap-close to the locked-on opponent before the slash. Independent Xenoverse 2 reports corroborate the Human/Saiyan restriction and charged teleport behavior. Exact frame, hitbox, damage, and probability values remain outside the evidence boundary.
records.acquisition_notes: Parallel Quest 38 — "Power Teams" is the documented Xenoverse 2 acquisition route. The live canonical record classifies it as a Basic Reward and explicitly records no Ultimate Finish requirement. No drop probability is inferred.
records.pve_notes: PQ38 acquisition; exact RNG behavior is unresolved and no unsupported drop probability is recorded.
records.pvp_notes: Charged gap-closing sword Strike Super; current player documentation corroborates its use as a gap closer. Exact tracking, frame, hitbox, and matchup claims remain version-sensitive.
